build_noisy_or_topic_model: build a NoisyOrTopic JAGS model with num_topics, num_words, and edge_weight parameters
generate_jags_code: generate JAGS model code for a Noisy-OR topic model with Bernoulli topic and word nodes
format_data_to_jags: format an xarray Dataset into a JAGS-compatible dictionary with sentence word observations
extract_data_from_jags: extract MCMC samples from JAGS output into an xarray Dataset with draw and topic dimensions
get_inference_vars: get the list of variables needed from inference which returns active topic nodes
